 How to Watch, Listen to & Stream Bills at Vikings in 2026 Week 9 Game
 Nov 06, 2026 at 03:31 PM Craig Peters Editing Director & Quality Control
 Copied! 
 EAGAN, Minn. — The Vikings (6-1) are hosting the Buffalo Bills (6-1) at 7:15 p.m. (CT) Monday, Nov. 9 to wrap Week 9 of the 2026 season.
 This will be just the 16 th official meeting between the franchises and first since playing an instant classic that Minnesota claimed 33-30 in overtime at Buffalo in 2022.
 The Monday Night Football matchup will be broadcast nationally on ABC (over the air) and ESPN (subscribers).
 The contest is Minnesota's annual Salute to Service game featuring multiple recognitions of veterans, active duty and reserve members of the military. It also is the backdrop for the much-anticipated ceremony to formally induct 2012 NFL MVP Adrian Peterson into the Vikings Ring of Honor. The ceremony will be livestreamed on Vikings.com and through the official Minnesota Vikings App.
 Although the game is Monday, Vikings GameDay Live will air on FOX 9 in the Twin Cities market from 9:30 a.m. to 11 a.m. (CT) on Sunday, Nov. 8.
